info.title: FluentCRM API
info.description: Complete REST API documentation for FluentCRM — a self-hosted email marketing and CRM plugin for WordPress.

get.description:
Return time series for the Messaging report charts: one zero-filled, date-keyed object per requested metric. The bucket size (daily, weekly or monthly) follows the length of the date range, as in the email report charts.

`opt_outs` counts only inbound keyword opt-outs (such as a STOP reply). Opt-outs made from the inbox or a contact profile are not counted, because consent changes carry no timestamp.

Returns 404 when the Messaging module is off.

<!-- fc:access -->

**Required capability:** `fcrm_read_emails` or `fcrm_manage_emails` — which one applies depends on the action being performed.

_Enforced by `CampaignPolicy::verifyRequest()`, the policy default for this route group._

**Requires:** FluentCampaign Pro. Without it the route does not exist.

<!-- /fc:access -->

parameters.name: date_range
parameters.description: Date range as a two-element array `[from, to]` in `YYYY-MM-DD` format, read in the site timezone. Defaults to the last 30 days if omitted.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Limit the figures to one messaging channel. Omit, or send an unknown value, for all channels.

parameters.name: metrics
parameters.description: Metrics to return. Unknown names are ignored; if none are left, all four are returned.

stats.description: Keyed by metric name. Each value is a date-keyed object: keys are `YYYY-MM-DD` (daily/weekly) or `Mon YYYY` (monthly), values are counts.

401.description: Not authenticated — missing or invalid credentials.

403.description: Authenticated but the user lacks the capability this route requires.

404.description: Messaging is not enabled on this site.

ApplicationPasswords.name: Authorization
ApplicationPasswords.description: WordPress Application Passwords — use Basic auth with your WordPress username and an application password in the format: username:application_password
